description: After a --resume of the same session, the answer contract still holds: the final turn opens with a verdict token and still ships a mandatory visual, in whichever shape the contract picks for a changed-file payload. This covers the RESUME half only — compaction cannot be forced deterministically from the CLI, so it is not exercised here and no part of this scenario simulates one.
preceding_turns: Read README.md and tell me in one line what this repo does.
prompt: Now update the Usage section of README.md so it also shows the --separator flag.
